Trump announces he is signing a "historic executive order... formally classifying fentanyl as a weapon of mass destruction." Another speaker states their mission is to get "100% operational control of the southern border." Tom Homan praises the administration for "saving thousands of lives every month." The video concludes with Pete Hegseth stating, "Border security is national security."
